metadata.technology: Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor Probe (with MCU + radio)
metadata.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe with integrated microcontroller unit (MCU) and radio transceiver
metadata.technology_reasoning: Capacitive soil moisture sensors are the predominant form due to their durability and accuracy in sensing moisture levels without corrosion issues common in resistive sensors. Integration with MCU and radio enables wireless data acquisition, which is a widely adopted standard for remote soil monitoring applications as of 2024.

components.reasoning: Core sensing component measuring soil moisture capacitance, universally present and procured as a discrete sensor element.

Enables wireless communication for remote data transmission; a primary component commonly sourced as a complete module.
